outcome: Bladder and urethra parameters (5 angles, 2 lengths, 1 thickness)
Lateral support function of vagina and urethra
cohort: 167 patients who had undergone magnetic resonance imaging for gynecological diseases at Nanfang Hospital were enrolled and divided into four groups based on their number of vaginal deliveries.
finding: Increasing numbers of vaginal deliveries, particularly beyond the third birth, are associated with a weakening of the lateral support function of the vagina and urethra, alongside specific 3D morphological changes.
mod_finding: The study found that increasing numbers of vaginal deliveries lead to distinct 3D morphological changes in the bladder, urethra, and vagina, specifically noting weakened lateral support and a tendency for mid-urethral/vaginal gaps to widen.
cross-section timing: Morphological data were measured at a single point in time, with patients retrospectively grouped by their historical number of vaginal deliveries.
